mapper.select: SELECT f.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.pgm_id, m.url, COALESCE(pi.icon, '') AS icon, f.sort_order FROM tb_user_favorite f JOIN tb_menu m ON f.menu_id = m.menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_pgm_info pi ON m.pgm_id = pi.pgm_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.created_at
SELECT menu_id FROM tb_menu WHERE pgm_id = #{pgmId} AND use_yn = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_favorite (user_id, menu_id, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{menuId}, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sort_order) + 1 FROM tb_user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}), 1), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_settings (user_id, setting_key, setting_value, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_user_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND setting_key = #{settingKey}
